title: Clusters
subtitle: Group your servers into clusters for a health rollup and group-wide operations.
empty: No clusters yet. Create one to organize your fleet.
name: Name
noMembers: No servers in this cluster yet.
deleteConfirm: Delete this cluster? Its servers are kept (only the grouping is removed).
swarmHint: Turn this cluster into a Docker Swarm: one manager, the rest join as workers.
swarmNone: No swarm yet. Form one to run multi-node workloads across these servers.
formSwarmHint: The chosen server becomes the swarm manager; every other online member joins as a worker.
dissolveConfirm: Dissolve this swarm? Every node leaves the swarm (your deployed apps are not removed).
swarmPortsWarn: Requires open ports between members: TCP 2377, TCP/UDP 7946, UDP 4789. Grant the 'swarm' capability to each server first.
addNodeHint: Join one more online server into the running swarm — the rest of the cluster is untouched.
addNodeFailed: Couldn't add the node to the swarm.
removeNodeConfirm: Remove {name} from this cluster's swarm? Its tasks will be drained onto the remaining nodes first, then it leaves the swarm and this cluster.
removeNodeFailed: Couldn't remove this node from the swarm.
quorumLost: Quorum lost — {online} of {total} managers online. The swarm can't process manager or service changes until a majority is back.
addManagerHint: Promote an existing worker, or have a fresh server join directly as a manager. Requires an already-formed swarm and the 'swarm' capability.
noEligibleServers: No eligible servers — must be online, have the 'swarm' capability, and not already be a manager.
ingressHint: How many Traefik replicas front this cluster's domains. 2+ survive a node failure (routing mesh) — they require DNS-01 (le-dns) on the manager.
ingressDnsHint: For failover, point one DNS A record at EACH node IP below (round-robin). Any listed node can serve every domain.
